Azure.description: Azure Key Vault secret store settings. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/modules/Secrets/.

VaultUri.description: The Azure Key Vault URI, e.g. 'https://myvault.vault.azure.net/'. Required to use the store.

NamePrefix.description: Application namespace prefix used even for single-tenant sites sharing a vault. The readable name is normalized, but the hash and ownership tags preserve the exact prefix. Changing this prefix requires explicit secret migration.

CredentialType.description: Required explicit credential provider. Use a deterministic provider in production. DefaultAzureCredential is used only when explicitly selected.

TenantId.description: The Microsoft Entra tenant ID. Required for ClientSecret and WorkloadIdentity authentication.

ClientId.description: Required for ClientSecret and WorkloadIdentity authentication. For ManagedIdentity, selects a user-assigned identity; omit to use the system-assigned identity.

ClientSecret.description: The application client secret. This is a sensitive value: provide it through user secrets, environment variables or a key vault rather than appsettings.json.

TokenFilePath.description: The federated token file path. Required for WorkloadIdentity authentication.
